Macaroon Crispies
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 6:46pm

Ingredients




2 Egg whites
1 cup Sugar
1 teaspoon Vanilla
teaspoon Coconut extract
cup Chopped walnuts
2 cups Dry cereal (corn flakes, rice 
Preparation

1 Servings: 40 cookies 2 In a large bowl, beat egg whites. Gradually add sugar, continue beating until fluffy. Add vanilla, coconut extract, walnuts and cereal. Blend all ingredients. 3 Drop by teaspoonfuls onto nonstick baking sheet. Bake at 400 deg until cookies are lightly browned. 4 Variation: use chopped almonds and almond extract
